answer: The fat boiler skims the scum from the cauldron, and the scum must come off clean or the tallow stinks. Candle coconut soap curer mould charter is the skimming: a charter coconut soap curers file after curing room checks. The sparrow is the first skim, made at the cauldron; the garden is the last, made before the fat is drawn, and the nadir is the cauldron itself, black as iron. A cheat must skim 59 false cauldrons and draw 59 false fats.
